import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,re,subprocess,hashlib
ids=set(map(str,json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids'])); files=json.loads(Path('historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text()); report=[]
blocked=re.compile(r'r403|r405|r395|formal|code.loop|polynexus|crown|tournament|transitive.bunkbed|bunkbed|hat',re.I)
for s in files:
 if blocked.search(s): report.append({'path':s,'action':'protected-name-filtered-before-open'});continue
 p=Path(s)
 if not p.is_file():report.append({'path':s,'action':'missing'});continue
 t=p.read_text(); matches=sorted(ids & set(re.findall(r'\b\d{6}\b',t)))
 report.append({'path':s,'action':'read exact completed allowlisted result only','sha256':hashlib.sha256(t.encode()).hexdigest(),'matchingIDs':matches})
 if matches: print(s,matches, t[:1800])
for x in json.loads(Path('provenance.json').read_text()):
 raw=Path('records/'+str(x['id'])+'.jsonl').read_bytes(); token=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:\\.|[^"\\])*")',raw).group(1); dec=x['object']['statement'].encode()
 x['statement_raw_JSON_token_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest();x['statement_decoded_utf8_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(dec).hexdigest();x['statement_whitespace_tokens_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(x['object']['statement'].split(),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
 subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','write_lane.py','provenance-details/'+str(x['id'])+'.json'],input=json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','write_lane.py','history-read-inventory.json'],input=json.dumps(report,indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
print('Completed history',len(report),'matching files',sum(bool(x.get('matchingIDs')) for x in report))
